title: Together Till the End - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Together Till the End trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Together Till the End phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Missable. Old Man Gen's request, and the window closes on entering Pangzhen.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Complete the side quest The Journey Home.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 21 of 36 on the list - before it The Last of Baishan · after it A Wanderer's Honor. It is missable, and the checklist of everything that expires is on the guide. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
